login.window.title: Welcome to PyMusic Client
login.manual.title: Sign in manually
login.manual.instructions:
Paste what you copy from your browser while signed in to music.youtube.com. Any of these options works:

• Chrome, Edge, Opera GX, Brave: F12 → Network → reload with Ctrl+R → filter by «browse» → right-click the request → Copy → Copy as cURL (bash or cmd).

• Firefox: F12 → Network → right-click a request to music.youtube.com → Copy value → Copy as cURL (Windows or POSIX).

• Any browser: export the music.youtube.com cookies with the Cookie-Editor extension (JSON format) or as cookies.txt, and paste them here.
login.error.title: Sign-in error
login.session.no_cookie: No cookie was found in what you pasted. Copy the full request (cURL) from a request to music.youtube.com while signed in, or export your cookies with the Cookie-Editor extension (JSON).
login.session.no_session: The cookies do not include your YouTube session (missing «__Secure-3PAPISID»). Make sure you signed in to music.youtube.com and copy again.
login.stream.no_runtime: This song is only available on YouTube Music Premium and the player needed to use your session was not found. Reinstall the app or install Node.js or Deno.
login.stream.no_session: This song is only available on YouTube Music Premium. Sign in with a Premium account.
login.stream.no_url: yt-dlp did not return an audio URL.
login.web.no_session: Your Google session is not detected yet. Finish signing in first.
login.web.retrying: Google rejected this attempt (it happens sometimes). Retrying…
login.web.gave_up: Google keeps rejecting sign-in from this window. Close it and try again in a few minutes, or use «Paste cURL or cookies».
